summary: The Sensex is building gains while the Nifty idles near 22,700. Breadth stays firmly positive, with buyers rotating into IT and PSU banks and out of metals and pharma.

detail.tone: Slightly better than 10:00: the latest headline has the Sensex up about 300 (from +167 at 10:00) with the Nifty still near 22,700. The last firm Nifty print was 22,723.10 at 10:00.
watch: The Nifty turning green above 22,716 (Tuesday's close)
